info.title: Workvivo video wizard — companies
info.description: Customers this tool has made videos for, for reconciliation against CRM records. Read-only.

bearerAuth.description: The value of COMPANIES_API_TOKEN, set as a Fly secret on the app.

name.description: Display spelling, capitalisation preferred. Match this against the CRM account name.

key.description: Case-folded, whitespace-collapsed name. Stable identity across spellings.

rendersAttempted.description: Renders started, including failed and aborted.

researchRuns.description: Times the wizard generated copy, whether or not a video followed.

lastVideoAt.description: Null when no render has completed.

get.summary: List companies the wizard has produced videos for
get.description: Rows are sorted most-recently-active first, so an incremental sync sees new entries without paging. The `basis` field in the response states which rule produced the list — read it rather than assuming it.

parameters.name: include
parameters.description: completed = at least one finished video. attempted = a render was started. researched = the wizard was run at all.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: ISO 8601. Keeps companies active on or after this instant.

basis.description: Prose statement of the rule used to select rows.

truncated.description: True when total exceeded limit. Raise limit rather than paging.

429.description: Ten failed attempts from this address; five-minute hold. A correct token is never rate limited.

503.description: COMPANIES_API_TOKEN is unset or shorter than 24 characters. The endpoint is off, not open.
